summary: Agent completed a subscription renewal (account action) and used the account payment method without completing the required verification steps. No personal-data leakage, promises, escalation or conduct issues were found.

findings.quote: Sure I can help. Please tell me your full name or account ID so I can look up your account.
findings.explanation: The agent asked for a name or account ID to look up the account but did not complete the required verification before making an account change. System logs (turn 23) show the account was updated with a subscription renewal, but there is no prior 'Account has been pulled up' system turn. Subscription payments/changes require full verification (full name, account ID and order ID); the transcript does not show the agent collected the order ID or completed verification before the renewal.

findings.quote: Or I can use the one on your account.
findings.explanation: The agent offered to use the stored card on the account and the system later shows the subscription was renewed (turn 23). Using a stored payment method and performing subscription/payment actions require full verification first; the agent did not complete full verification (name, account ID and order ID) before proceeding.
